decisions.reason: The retail system interface plugin still fits our integration and customization strengths for shop clients, but as a comparatively niche software add-on its portfolio priority is lower than our core service offerings.
Shop relaunch SEO support remains a close fit with our relaunch, marketing, analytics, and conversion services and is a straightforward revenue-generating part of our core offer.
SEO workshops complement our consulting and can generate leads for broader projects, though training formats are somewhat less central and more discretionary than implementation services.
